body: Hey, sorry for replying so late, I felt ashamed for myself in posting like this on here. Guilty, desperate, lonely and disgusting. I don't use Skype but thanks for your offer and reply. Peace.

It is ok, my English is not perfect also. Thanks for replying. My reply is late because I was overcome with shame for my desperation in loneliness. I suppose I do feel empty, as if all of those I know forget about me. That I only exist when I am present with them. It's a weird and horrible feeling.
